'''Joshua Stecker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2002 Booster Pack Games tournament]] on 23 March 2002 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]], according to Greg Otte's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3539">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-27-booster-pack-games-03-23-2002d3539/ booster-pack-games-03-23-2002], DeckTech (Greg "Rogue 9" Otte, 27 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-27-booster-pack-games-03-23-2002d3539/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
